external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague of a franchise store who signs in through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies group membership changes and leaver information overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

external_entities.name: franchise identity provider
external_entities.description: A franchise's identity provider that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, validates external sign-ins, and supplies public signing keys.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: application
processes.description: An application that consumes identity tokens and decides what a colleague may do from the groups in the token.
processes.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that allows a holder of a store-manager token to change prices and void transactions.
processes.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their groups.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A franchise colleague signs in through the identity broker using a vouch from their identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.

data_flows.name: vouch for colleague
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague to the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.data_description: A vouch for a franchise colleague's identity.

data_flows.name: pull membership changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group membership and leaver changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker updates its directory with colleagues and group memberships.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: read directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker reads colleague and group information from its directory.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: keep signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps its token-signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues tokens to applications for colleagues.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying a staff id and group list.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker supplies the store admin console with a colleague's token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying a staff id and group list.

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: Applications fetch the public half of the broker's signing key to check token signatures.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: The public half of the token-signing key.

data_flows.name: administer stores
data_flows.description: A colleague uses the store admin console to change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: Colleagues' own devices at home, controlled outside the corporate system.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise-store environment controlled by franchise organisations.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's data is confidential because it contains colleagues and their group memberships, which identify or describe people.
assumptions.basis: The source says the directory keeps colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's data is confidential because it contains a token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source says the key store keeps the signing key used to sign tokens.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log's data is confidential because it contains sign-in records associated with colleagues.
assumptions.basis: The source says the broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
